text:
Ana (Marketing): Quick sync — need to finalize landing copy for deployment-mode pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) before Wed launch. Focus: one headline per mode, 2-line subhead, webinar CTA + inbound form routing. Thoughts?

Mike (Growth): Love it. Can we push stronger on cost/latency tradeoffs for Dedicated? Maybe 'Predictable throughput, lower tail latency.'

Jess (PMM): For Private, emphasize compliance + VPC/KMS. Suggested subhead: 'Enterprise control, in your network.'

Sam (Design): I'll drop updated hero comps in Figma by EOD: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/landing-modes

Ana (Marketing): Awesome. For webinar CTA copy, lean 'benchmark session' vs 'webinar' — which performs better?

Oliver (Analytics): Data: 'benchmark session' had +12% CTR in last cohort. Recommend that phrasing.

Mike (Growth): Routing: new inbound form should tag leads by mode interest. Here's mapping:

``
form_field: deployment_mode
values: hosted,dedicated,private
utm_source: webinar-landing
``

Ana (Marketing): Perfect. Sam can you wire form to SalesHub with mode tag? @Sam (Design)

Sam (Design): Yup. I'll add mapping and a hidden field for `deployment_mode`. Ping me if CRM mapping changes.

Ana (Marketing): Draft hero headlines:

- Hosted API: 'Start generating in minutes — fast, managed inference.'
- Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU capacity for production-scale SLAs.'
- Private: 'Bring inference into your VPC — enterprise controls.'

Feedback?

Jess (PMM): Hosted one feels generic. Maybe: 'Hosted API — instant deployment, predictable costs.' shorter.

Mike (Growth): Also propose CTA variants: 'Start free', 'Request dedicated demo', 'Book private pilot'

Ana (Marketing): Let's A/B test hosted hero CTA vs 'Start free' on 50/50 for 2 weeks. Sam to hook experiment.

Sam (Design): On it. I'll set up experiment id: exp-landing-1769

deploy-bot: Scheduled: webinar 'Real-world inference benchmarks' on 2024-05-15 10:00 PDT — registration page: https://redwood.ai/webinar

Ana (Marketing): Great. I'll update copy doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/landing-modes-copy (editable). I'll push final before EOD tomorrow. :rocket:

Mike (Growth): Thanks — can someone add a short sentence under each hero about unit economics? e.g., 'optimizes tokens/second for lower cost.'

Jess (PMM): I'll write 1-liners. Ana assign me?

Ana (Marketing): Assigned to Jess. Closing notes: finalize hero texts, CTA variants, form routing, and webinar hook. Sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
